raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation Nemotron VL image requests fail when callers supply a tokenized prompt through `generate(input_ids=...)`: the processor assumes a string and calls `.replace()` on the list. ## Modifications - Accept tokenized prompts and expand media placeholders directly in token IDs, without re-tokenizing surrounding text. - Use the original text IDs for image budgeting and validate image/video placeholder counts before loading. - Preserve text unknown IDs when normalizing generated video markers. The existing string-prompt path remains supported. This replaces the original decode/re-encode implementation with the token-preserving processor fix previously included in #44581; it does not change the vision encoder or weights. ## Why expand token IDs directly? The immediate 500 occurs because `generate(input_ids=..., image_data=...)` passes a list to a processor that assumes a string and calls `.replace()`. Decoding that list to text would avoid the exception, but a decode/re-encode round trip can change the surrounding text IDs. `_media_token_ids` identifies placeholders represented by a single token; `_splice_media` expands those placeholders directly in the ID list and leaves surrounding text IDs unchanged. These helpers are not required merely to avoid `.replace()` on a list; they make tokenized-prompt support preserve the caller's text IDs. ## Accuracy Tests All **5 CPU tests** in the existing `test_nano_nemotron_vl_processor.py` pass, covering tokenized image expansion/budgeting, invalid image counts, text unknown-ID preservation, and the existing tubelet/EVS cases. Project isort/ruff checks pass. GPU/serving validation has not been rerun for this split. ## Related PR **Merge first in the stack:** #44581 adds offset-based image padding to prevent literal `` / `` text from being mistaken for image boundaries. That follow-up is a separate fix. ## Speed Tests and Profiling Not benchmarked; no performance claim or kernel changes. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :white_check_mark: [Run #39506916262](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39506916262) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #39506916549](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39506916549) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #39506916289](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39506916289)

+    def _media_token_ids(self) -> dict[int, str]:
+        """Only placeholders represented by a single token can be spliced."""
+        candidates = {
+            self.mm_tokens.image_token_id: self.IMG_CONTEXT_TOKEN,
+            self.mm_tokens.video_token_id: self.VIDEO_CONTEXT_TOKEN,
+            self.mm_tokens.audio_token_id: self.AUDIO_CONTEXT_TOKEN,
+        }
+        return {
+            tid: text
+            for tid, text in candidates.items()
+            if tid is not None and self.tokenizer.convert_ids_to_tokens(tid) == text
+        }
+
+    def _splice_media(
+        self, token_ids: list[int], renders: dict[int, list[str]]
+    ) -> list[int]:
+        """Replace placeholder IDs without re-tokenizing surrounding text."""
+        pending = {
+            tid: deque(rendered) for tid, rendered in renders.items() if rendered
+        }
+        expanded = []
+        for tid in token_ids:
+            queue = pending.get(tid)
+            if queue:
+                expanded.extend(
+                    self.tokenizer.encode(queue.popleft(), add_special_tokens=False)
+                )
+            else:
+                expanded.append(tid)
+        audio_id = self.mm_tokens.audio_token_id
+        if audio_id is not None:
+            # Audio extracted from video may not have an explicit placeholder.
+            for rendered in pending.pop(audio_id, ()):
+                expanded.extend(
+                    self.tokenizer.encode(rendered, add_special_tokens=False)
+                )
+        if any(pending.values()):
+            raise ValueError("More media items than media placeholders in prompt")
+        return expanded
+
